arStrings.szText:
After defeating all Bosses within the {c_important}Greater Nemesis Lair{/c}, the {c_important}Call Of Evil{/c} will appear. This altar will accept 3 {c_blue}Superior Lair Keys{/c} and open a Portal that takes you to the {c_unique}Ultimate Nemesis Lair{/c}.

Inside the {c_unique}Ultimate Nemesis Lair{/c}, all enemies gain +5 {c_important}{u}{b}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}. Defeating the Boss Encounter will award you with 10 {c_important}{u}{b}Hoard Chests{/c}{/b}{/u} worth of Items.
